purpose: Resolve current-versus-previous-versus-prior-year period roles and original-versus-converted currency roles before any text feature training
scope: The same 12 fixed official CNINFO documents; no return, price, rank-IC or portfolio data
fixed_outputs: Fact role: current guidance, previous guidance, prior-year comparator, contract original currency, converted RMB or unbound
acceptance: Every approved numeric fact traces to an immutable PDF hash and literal page context
No unbound numeric candidate is silently promoted to a fact
Scan-only document remains quarantined unless a separately verified OCR path exists
A manually frozen gold subset is evaluated before expanding coverage
historical_pit_verified remains false until historical availability is independently established
